text:
Agent Deck

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

Install . Quick Start . Connect your assistant . Docs . Discord . FAQ

 

Agent Deck runs all your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI, OpenCode and more) in one terminal and shows which ones are working, waiting, or done.

 

 Installation

Works on macOS, Linux and Windows (WSL).

 

Or with Homebrew:

 

Other ways to install, updates, uninstall and shell completion: Install and update.

 Quick Start

 

The keys you need first:

 Key Action 
 ----- -------- 
 Enter Attach to session 
 Ctrl+Q Detach from session 
 n New session 
 / Search 
 Alt+W Show me around: what you can do, your agents and sign-in 
 Alt+N What's new: this version's highlights and your reports it fixed 
 ? Help ( Tab for all keys) 

More commands and every key: Quick start and keys.

 Connect your assistant

Paste this into your assistant (Hermes, OpenClaw, Grok, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex...):

 

It checks agent-deck, connects itself, saves its own config and tests it. Or run agent-deck connect and paste what it prints, or use the Connect page in agent-deck web .

Your assistant can only read your sessions at first (read-only). You choose if it may do more. Details: Connect an assistant.

install.html:
Works on macOS, Linux and Windows (WSL).

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asheshgoplani/agent-deck/main/install.sh | bash

Or with Homebrew:

brew install asheshgoplani/tap/agent-deck
